snippet.title: Through the Void: Echoes — Dark Fantasy RPG | Official Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Through the Void: Echoes — Official Gameplay Trailer

Enter a brutal dark fantasy RPG where power is earned through relentless progression, deadly combat, and the pursuit of legendary loot.

Choose your class, master your skills, hunt powerful bosses, and push your character beyond its limits. The Void offers no mercy.

Wishlist on Steam

Features

Dark fantasy RPG progression
Multiple character classes and skills
Loot hunting and powerful equipment
Challenging boss encounters and endgame raids


#IndieGame #RPG #DarkFantasy #indie
